about: UK legal values for the Sustainability engine (sus-engine-uk.js). Every row carries source, source_url, status, version and checked_on. Nations: E England, W Wales, S Scotland, N Northern Ireland. Phase 0 (PREBUILD-CHECK-V53 §4.2). Phase 2 (-435-sus2) adds crop N max (nmax), closed periods per product (fym, absolute, exceptions), soil testing (soil) and the Red Tractor urea standard (limits.urea_rt). Phase 4 (-436-sus4, 15 Nov 2026) adds abstraction thresholds per nation (R14). The register import (-438-sus5r, 15 Nov 2026) adds the reporting windows per nation (register: birth_days, death_days, move_days_cattle, move_days_sheep; RESEARCH-DECISIONS-NOV-2026.md section E). -439-sus6 (15 Nov 2026): owner standing rule, nothing from the mock-up. Closed periods never refuse (record with a reason), Scotland bagged-N exceptions, worst-4-months SSAFO, NI goats 5 Jan, crop-available N per nation in law, NI register rows confirmed, Scotland WFP soil pH P K C, and every product choice labelled. -445 (24 Nov 2026, owner decision "recorded late"): closed.record_rule.value.within_days per nation - England and Wales 7 days (SI 2015/668 reg 31, WSI 2021/77 reg 40), Scotland and Northern Ireland null (no per-spreading limit); additive, so the version stays 2026.1.

status_values.confirmed: read from the regulation or the regulator's page on checked_on
status_values.estimate: not a legal value, or not confirmed; always shown tagged
status_values.pending: read from a dated source, but one reading is still open; the app takes the lower figure and tags it "to confirm"
status_values.assumption: no published figure: a labelled assumption the farmer ticks (or changes) before it is used; never a silent default

field_organic_n.label: Organic manure N on any hectare in 12 months

field_organic_n.note: Total N from all organic manures spread on any one hectare in any 12 months. Certified compost has its own 500/1,000 kg limits. -439-sus6: Scotland confirmed (reg 15(1): 250 kg in any 12 months, grazing excluded; compost 500 in 24 months). occupier_rule.label: Stock on land (including outdoor pigs) counts on the holding of whoever has the land at their disposal (the occupier). A tenant who occupies counts it; the landowner counts it only if they keep occupation (licence or contract B&B).

nmax.label: Crop N max: the most nitrogen (manufactured plus crop-available N from organic manures) over the area of each crop, kg N/ha

Pending (change 69): whether part tonnes count. The regulation and gov.uk say "every tonne" and neither mentions part tonnes, so the app counts FULL tonnes only (the lower figure) and tags any part tonne "to confirm". Expected yield: the farmer's estimate from farm records (gov.uk); the regulation does not define it. Oilseed rape: the 30 kg autumn cap and the half-tonne rise are shown as a note, not added.

deaths_rule.label: Until you say how many left the farm, every pig or bird placed is counted (the higher figure)
deaths_rule.source: No mortality rule in NISR 2019/81 Schedule 2 Tables 1b/1c (source audit L16)
deaths_rule.note: Ask: "How many went off the farm from this batch?" Until answered: a labelled assumption the farmer ticks, "We count every pig or bird placed".

defaults.note: Stage not answered, so the highest legal figure (source audit L17): pigs weaned to 105 kg 2.38, weaners to 35 kg 0.38, turkeys 0 to kill 534. Not from the mock-up.

cattle.label: All holdings: 22 weeks
cattle.note: NAP 2019 still in force; DAERA consulted on NAP 2026-29 / 2027-30 (closed 7 Sep 2026). Re-check before NI launch.

pig.label: Holdings with a pig enterprise: 26 weeks

poultry.label: Holdings with a poultry enterprise: 26 weeks

small_unit_places.label: Under 10 breeding sow, 150 finishing or 500 poultry places: 22 weeks instead of 26

assumed_start.label: The law sets the weeks but no start date: we assume they run from 1 October (you can change it)
assumed_start.source: No start date in NISR 2019/81 reg 17 (source audit L4)
assumed_start.note: Owner decision "weeks" a, kept as a labelled assumption: shown as "assumed from 1 October". The farmer can pick another start.

exceptions.bagN_arable: Non-grass crops may get chemical N in the closed period where there is a demonstrable crop requirement (reg 7(2)).

lawful_routes.label: Crops other than grass with a demonstrable crop requirement in the closed period

within_days.label: A spreading is recorded within this many days of the spreading (null: no per-spreading time limit)
within_days.quote: shall be prepared for each calendar year by 30th June of the following year
within_days.note: Northern Ireland: the records are prepared for each calendar year by 30 June of the following year, so there is no per-spreading limit and a late record is never flagged.

record_rule.label: Every spreading is recorded, inside a closed period too: it is saved with a warning and a reason ("None: possible breach" is a reason)
record_rule.note: RESEARCH-DECISIONS-NOV-2026 A; owner decision "closed" option a, 15 Nov 2026. Refusing would block lawful entries and the mandatory record.

closed.label: Closed periods (MM-DD, inclusive; a period may run over New Year)
closed.note: Non-grass crops may get chemical N in the closed period with a demonstrable crop requirement (reg 7(2)). NAP 2019 still in force; DAERA consulted on NAP 2026-29 / 2027-30 (closed 7 Sep 2026). Re-check before NI launch. Phase 2: "fym" = solid manure with low readily available N (none in England, Wales and Scotland; NI 31 Oct-31 Jan, reg 7(4)). "no_exception_in_law" only changes the wording; the app never refuses a date (-439-sus6).

sheep_return.label: Sheep: count between 1 and 5 December; return by 30 December
sheep_return.route: DAERA Online Services (NOL), or the online link in DAERA's letter (one return for sheep, one for goats)
sheep_return.source: DAERA, Go online to complete your sheep and goat inventories (2 Dec 2021); duty under the Sheep and Goats (Records, Identification and Movement) Order (NI) 2009
sheep_return.note: The dated DAERA notice read is 2021; the same 1-5 Dec / 30 Dec dates appear for 2025 in DAERA's inventory page as indexed (14 Nov 2026), but that page now shows only the 2026 pig and bird inventories. Re-check against DAERA's 2026 letter. -439-sus6: goats split out (their own row, due 5 January).

adj.evidence: overall farm crop yield in any of the previous three years

nmax.label: Maximum permitted nitrogen for cereal crops (NI), kg N/ha
nmax.note: "an additional 20 kg N/ha is permitted for every tonne that the expected yield exceeds the standard yield"; evidence must be shown by overall farm crop yield in any of the previous three years. Only cereals have a table; grassland and other crops follow the plan and the P limits (Sch 3).

value.scope: fields where chemical P fertiliser is planned; one sample per field, no more than 4 ha

soil.label: Soil analysis for P: sampling every fourth year is the basis for P recommendations (NAP)

notify_over.label: More than 10 m³ a day: tell NIEA

licence_over.label: More than 20 m³ a day needs a licence
licence_over.source: DAERA, Abstraction and impoundment licensing requirements; Water Abstraction and Impoundment (Licensing) Regulations (NI) 2006

birth_days.label: Calf births registered within 27 days
birth_days.source: DAERA NIFAIS bovine herd register guidance (18 Aug 2026); DAERA Farm Sustainability Standard 7 (Dec 2025)
birth_days.note: Source audit L14: 20 days to tag + 7 to record.

death_days.label: Cattle deaths reported within 7 days
death_days.source: DAERA NIFAIS bovine herd register guidance (18 Aug 2026); Farm Sustainability Standard 7 (Dec 2025)

move_days_cattle.label: Cattle moves: late after 7 days, with a reminder at 3
move_days_cattle.source: DAERA NIFAIS bovine herd register guidance (18 Aug 2026): "within 3 days"; DAERA Farm Sustainability Standard 7 (Dec 2025): "within 7 days"
move_days_cattle.note: Our rule: the sources conflict, so a move is flagged late after 7 days and we remind at 3. Shown as "DAERA's guidance asks for 3 days; the scheme standard allows 7".

move_days_sheep.label: Sheep and goat moves recorded within 7 days

goat_return.label: Goats: count between 1 and 5 December; return to DAERA by 5 January
goat_return.route: DAERA Online Services, a separate goat return
goat_return.source: DAERA, Goats identification quick guide (12 May 2026)
goat_return.note: Source audit L15. Sheep stay 1-5 Dec and 30 Dec.

crop_available_n.label: Share of total N counted as available to the crop, by manure
crop_available_n.note: Read 15 Nov 2026: chemical 100, pig slurry 50, poultry litter 30, farmyard manure 30, cattle slurry 40, spent mushroom compost 20, other organic manures 40 (%). NI FYM is 30%, not 10%. Digestate: no default; the supplier's analysis is asked (source audit L13).

value.method: the 80th percentile of the farm's whole-season rainfall totals over its Rainfall normal (ERA5, about 30 seasons) divided by the average season scales each average month (never below 1); the season total exceeded in 1 year in 5. The average, said plainly, when the percentile is missing or under 10 seasons

rain_wet_year.label: Rain on open stores: a 1-in-5 wet season at your farm (our method)
rain_wet_year.source: gov.uk, Storing organic manures in NVZs (updated 12 Oct 2023): allow for wetter than average years (1 in 5)
rain_wet_year.note: Source audit L7. No published conversion exists (AHDB's Slurry Wizard uses CEH data internally); the method is ours, the 1-in-5 basis is gov.uk. Replaced the earlier month-by-month second-wettest method, which stacked wet months that don't fall in the same year and overstated rain.

store_tight_days.label: We warn 6 weeks before a store is full

register_old_days.label: A register file over 30 days old is flagged

register_refused_share.label: Over 1 in 10 rows refused: we ask "right file?"

sheep_return_job_days.label: The sheep return job shows 45 days before the count

last_crop_days.label: An application more than 60 days before planting belongs to the last crop

nmax_whole_tonnes.label: We count whole tonnes only above the standard yield (the law says "for every tonne")
